subject: Staged acceptance canvas & probe tests — MAP proposal and acceptance rubric
messages:
From: Priyom Das <pri@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <a.turner@helio.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Staged acceptance canvas & probe tests — MAP proposal and acceptance rubric

Alex — thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I put together a concise staged-acceptance canvas and an initial set of probe tests so your engineering and compliance teams can validate fit during the evaluation.

High-level proposal (attached and pasted below):
- Goal: Prove production readiness for a 50 QPS inference path with end-to-end P95 latency <= 350ms for the demo dataset (10K sample) and no data retention on our hosted flow.
- Primary success criteria: accuracy/throughput/latency thresholds met in three progressive gates (smoke, functional, scale).
- Exit gates: smoke pass -> feature tests pass -> scale pass. Each gate has clear acceptance tests (see acceptance-tests.md).
- Timeline: 3-week pilot (week 1: smoke & integration; week 2: functional edgecases; week 3: scale & regression).
- Rollback triggers: >5% degradation in accuracy vs baseline or >2x expected tail latency for two consecutive runs.

Attachments: MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP milestones & owners), acceptance-tests.md (test scripts & metrics), mutual-action-plan-drive-link.txt (Drive link to canonical MAP).

Quick asks:
1) Please confirm the proposed gate thresholds are acceptable to your SRE and product teams.
2) Can you share the final list of sample queries and a sandbox API key for the test window?
3) Is procurement/contract okay with the 3-week evaluation cadence or should we extend?

If that works I’ll schedule the kickoff for Tue 9/14 and loop in your procurement contact.

Thanks,
Priyom Das

Priyom — appreciate the clear layout. Quick answers and a few clarifying requests from our side: 

- Overall the gate thresholds look reasonable. Our SRE asked whether P95 targets are measured on your hosted path or our dedicated capacity (we prefer dedicated for accurate SLA alignment).
- Procurement (Lisa cc’d) asked for a 4-week window instead of 3 to accommodate legal review and SOC2 evidence checks.
- For acceptance tests, can you add an explicit data deletion verification step and an audit-log sample? We need to be able to demonstrate data lineage for regulators.

We’ll provide the sample query set and a sandbox key by EOD Tue (13 Sep). I’ll also get procurement’s redline timeframe — belief is 4 weeks is more likely.

—Alex

Alex/Priyom — quick technical clarifications and suggested additions to the acceptance-tests.md: 

1) Measurement environment: we will run the scale gate on dedicated capacity (same model build as production). I’ll include the exact instance types and kernel/quantization profile we’ll use in the acceptance-tests doc.
2) Data deletion verification: add a two-step: (a) ingest synthetic marker tokens in a test partition; (b) trigger retention purge; (c) verify no marker tokens return in subsequent queries + retention audit log entry. I’ll add a sample curl sequence.
3) Observability checks: add token-level cost breakdown and KV cache hit-rate >= 70% for prefix-heavy loads as pass criteria.
4) Concordance: for functional gate we’ll require >= 92% intent-match against your label set (we’ll run 10k labeled examples).

I attached inline snippets to inclusion in acceptance-tests.md — see bottom of this message. If procurement needs 4 weeks that’s fine; schedule-wise we should keep activity windows the same but expand slack for contract sign-off.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

- Add explicit SLA targets tied to gates (uptime, P95 latency) and include an interim smoke-test callout that’s customer-observable. Helio should be able to run a single-shot smoke script and validate latency & correctness within 30 minutes.
- Add a priority owner's name on each MAP line item (I’ve added owners in the attached MAP-draft.xlsx; Priyom please confirm).
- For rollback triggers, include a short communications runbook: who to notify (CS lead + SRE + legal) and the template messages.

Priyom — can you produce a short kickoff agenda and a 30min smoke-test script we can run together during week 1? If procurement needs 4 weeks we’re OK to stretch the timeline, but flagging that it pushes the demo/scale window one week later.

thanks,
